_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/AmalgamPan/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, one cell, the controller [0,0,0]: the pan. A hand station: no power cell, no work. theta is the crank's angle, the hold-to-work clock: the crank turns by it about its shaft (z), and the gears under the pan (6 teeth to 9) turn the muller by 2/3 of it about the pan's axis (y). Every part but the contents is always fitted. The contents are requires values: mercury and amalgam, one drawn at a time. See the amalgam pan's README for the schema.
